svg.aria-label: The Edge of the Sunbreak: a flat snowfield under a low overcast deck, with one break of sun. The far edge of the sunlight, and the width of the softness at that edge, are computed from the solar elevation, the cloud base and the angular size of the sun, not painted by eye.
svg.text: where the light stops on the snow, 14.6 m to 27.6 m
penumbra = hᴄ[cot(e−θ) − cot(e+θ)] = 12.97 m, over 1600 px of field
